prompts.cap: Use case: product-mockup. Asset type: single photorealistic AR virtual try-on hat PNG cutout. Subject: a navy blue baseball cap, curved visor projecting forward, realistic woven cotton and seams. Straight-on frontal view, camera at forehead level, symmetric wearable orientation, realistic studio product photography, soft neutral light. Hat only, no head, no face, no person, no mannequin, no pedestal, no cast shadow outside the object. Entire hat completely in frame, centered horizontally, transparent background with real alpha, tight composition with only a small equal margin. The inside rear of the head opening must be naturally occluded by the front band: intended as an overlay resting on a person's forehead. No cartoon, illustration, emoji, text, logos, watermark. Generate only this single hat, not a sheet or collage.
